note: The hero's sounds (design.md, Sound), baked by the editor's SoundBaker into the ignored Assets/Baked/Sounds/Resources/ before every build. Each category (Client/Sound/SoundScheduler.cs's SoundKind) lists its variants by vendor file name (manifest.json's sound entries); gain is the category's level, and the aggregation multiplies it by the beat's gain (0.35 for one sound, growing with log2 of the count, at most three voices a beat). limit is the effects' level under the music, which is never ducked. Ported from game/Content/sounds.json: the swings, hits, slam and the crystal shatter are its choices; the dash's whoosh is new (game/ reused the swing), the accent under on-beat dashes is game/'s on-beat heavy swing, and the hurt is an armour hit (game/'s was a free sample).
